result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly related to cut-off cards and inconsistent visual elements in the horizontal scroll sections.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only a partial view of the restaurant card and truncated name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll container padding or add a visual cue (like a fade/gradient edge) to indicate more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off at the right edge with an additional category partially visible, making it unclear there are more options.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visibility indicator at the edge to signal scrollability, or ensure consistent card widths.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card is white and blends into the light-colored ramen bowl image background, reducing visibility.
issues.suggestion: Add a semi-transparent dark background circle behind the heart icon for better contrast against varying image backgrounds.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off, showing only the top portion of the image with a '-20%' badge, without any visible restaurant name or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card layout accounts for viewport cutoff gracefully, or add lazy-loading placeholders so the cut isn't jarring mid-image.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card image appears generic/placeholder-like with a simple plate icon rather than an actual appetizing food photo.
issues.suggestion: Replace with a higher-quality, realistic food photograph to improve visual appeal and consistency with other cards.

issues.description: Notification bell icon has a small red dot indicator but lacks any visible count or aria-label context for screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., 'You have new notifications') and consider showing a count badge if applicable.
